title: ginkgo biloba var. pendula
intro: Ginkgo biloba var. pendula, commonly known as the Weeping Ginkgo, is a slow-growing, deciduous tree native to China, characterized by its unique, pendulous branches. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for centuries to promote health and well-being, with health benefits including improved memory and cognitive function, as well as enhanced blood flow to the brain and extremities. The therapeutic actions of Ginkgo biloba var. pendula are attributed to its ability to increase oxygenation of tissues, protect against oxidative stress, and modulate inflammatory responses. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, such as quercetin and kaempferol, as well as terpenoids, including ginkgolides and bilobalide, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
